# Avenue Supermarts Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Search and document budget (~8 searches, 6 documents) reached. FY2022-23's full statutory CSR annexure (only a partial unspent-transfer figure was recovered) and DMart Foundation's own registration identifiers/independent financials were not located within budget; the NSE archive copy of the FY2024-25 annual report also failed to download (timeouts), though an equivalent copy was obtained from MSEI.

Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart, CIN L51900MH2000PLC126473) is a Section 135-bound listed retailer whose statutory CSR annexures for FY2023-24 (spent Rs 42.57 crore against a Rs 47.04 crore obligation) and FY2024-25 (spent Rs 41.50 crore against a Rs 60.84 crore obligation) were read directly from its Board's Report annexures; only a partial FY2022-23 figure (Rs 6.12 crore unspent-transfer) was recovered. DMart Foundation is confirmed by the FY2024-25 annual report as 'a public charitable trust registered under the Mumbai Trusts Act, 1950' that 'serves as the implementing agency for select CSR initiatives of Avenue Supermarts Ltd' (e.g. the Skilling Programme-ITI), and is recorded as a separate funder row with parent_name Avenue Supermarts Limited rather than merged with it. CSR activity spans a flagship 'School Excellence Programme' (education, Maharashtra cities, >136,000-145,000 students across FY2023-24/24-25), Akshaya Patra mid-day meals in Bhiwandi, Dakshana/Udayan Care/Shanti Bhavan/IIT Bombay education partnerships, Tata Trusts-partnered water conservation (Gujarat/Maharashtra) and cancer care (Assam, an aspirational district), and a Central Railways sanitation partnership. Note: the catalog's own fuzzy-match tool (research_goals/funder_dossier) resolved a query for 'DMart Foundation' to an unrelated existing record, SBI Foundation [funder:9] - this is a name-similarity artifact, not evidence the two are related, and no DMart Foundation data was merged with SBI Foundation's held facts.

Website: https://www.dmartindia.com

## What it set out to find

- CSR identity for Avenue Supermarts Ltd and DMart Foundation (name, type, section 135 status, website, parent relationship)
- Identifiers (CIN, PAN, domain, reg_no, CSR-1) for both entities
- CSR annexure figures (prescribed CSR, spend, unspent, admin overheads, impact assessment) for FY2022-23 to FY2024-25
- Project-level CSR spend, implementing agencies, aspirational-district spend
- Geographic footprint of CSR activity vs stated priority geography
- Partner NGOs/foundations/agencies by year
- Programme/project hierarchy
- Outcome/output metrics for flagship programmes
- Contacts (CSR committee) and source documents
